description: This file is a shell script (bash/sh) used for testing the application of patches in Git, specifically for testing git-apply functionality with removal patches, creation patches, and other diff-related scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, with a description and a script of commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files to ensure they are identical.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Ensures that a specified file is empty.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
